Layer 4 · Money

What does the first year cost?

Registration is the cheap part. This calculator adds the address, the accountant, the audit, the payroll and the buffer — the lines founders discover in month three rather than month one.

Year one, all-in —
  • One-off setup (agent, seals, bank)—
  • Registered address—
  • Bookkeeping and filings—
  • Annual audit—
  • Payroll service—
  • Employer social insurance and fund—
  • Your salary (12 months)—
  • Working buffer (3 months of costs)—

What is not in this number

  • Rent and fit-out for licensed premises
  • Your own individual income tax
  • Sector licence fees and consultant costs
  • VAT and corporate income tax on revenue
  • Legal work on contracts, IP or a JV
Read the capital guide

What a tool cannot decide

The number is the start of the argument, not the end of it.

This tool answers one question. The framework is where that answer is tested against the other four.
